title: Aggressor flow
description: Dollars traded by buyers minus sellers who crossed the spread. It shows who is in a hurry.

signed_notional_usd_10s.label: Net flow 10s
signed_notional_usd_10s.description: Buyer-initiated dollars minus seller-initiated dollars over the last ten seconds. Positive means buyers are lifting offers.

signed_notional_usd_60s.label: Net flow 60s
signed_notional_usd_60s.description: The same net dollars over the last minute. Slower, but a run of one sign is a real lean.

cumulative_volume_delta_base_60s.label: Volume delta 60s
cumulative_volume_delta_base_60s.description: Net flow over the last minute measured in BTC instead of dollars. Positive means more was bought aggressively than sold.

flow_direction_10s.label: Flow direction 10s
flow_direction_10s.description: The sign of the ten-second flow once it clears a small threshold. Neutral when buyers and sellers are balanced.
